inbox_empty: Nothing here yet. Reminders and alerts show up in this list.
channels_intro: Reminders and alerts always reach the inbox. A channel also sends them to a chat, a phone or an email address. Only administrators can see or change channels.
channels_docs: How to set up each kind
channels_empty: No channels yet. Notifications still arrive in the inbox.
channel_enabled_hint: A channel that is off keeps its settings and sends nothing.
channel_events_hint: The inbox gets every event whatever is ticked here.
channel_test_failed: The test message was not sent: {error}
channel_secret_saved: A value is saved and hidden. Leave this empty to keep it.
channel_about_discord: Posts each notification to a Discord channel through a webhook.
channel_discord_url_hint: In Discord, open the channel's settings, then Integrations and Webhooks, create a webhook and copy its URL. The URL is a secret: anyone who has it can post to the channel.
channel_about_slack: Posts each notification to a Slack channel through an incoming webhook.
channel_slack_url_hint: Add the Incoming Webhooks app to your Slack workspace, pick a channel and copy the URL. The URL is a secret: anyone who has it can post to the channel.
channel_about_ntfy: Sends each notification as a push message to the ntfy app on your phone.
channel_ntfy_server_hint: Leave as https://ntfy.sh to use the public service, or enter the address of your own ntfy server.
channel_ntfy_topic_hint: Anyone who knows the topic name can read the messages, so choose a long one that is hard to guess. It is kept secret here.
channel_ntfy_token_hint: Only needed when the topic requires sign-in. It is kept secret.
channel_about_webhook: Sends each notification to an address of your choosing, so another program can act on it.
channel_webhook_url_hint: Each notification is sent to this address as an HTTP POST with a JSON body. Addresses on your own network work. The URL is a secret.
channel_about_email: Sends each notification as an email through a mail server you choose.
channel_email_host_hint: The name of your SMTP server, such as smtp.example.com.
channel_email_port_hint: Usually 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for TLS and 25 for no encryption.
channel_email_security_hint: A server outside this machine should use STARTTLS or TLS, so the password is never sent in the clear.
channel_email_starttls: STARTTLS (starts plain, then switches to encryption)
channel_email_none: None (only for a server on this machine)
channel_email_from_hint: Shown as the sender, for example reefshepherd@example.com.
channel_email_to_hint: One or more addresses, separated by commas.
